destinationMatching.description: What the destination is asked to match an existing record on. One entry per record mapping when the import mode matches an existing record; empty under CREATE_ONLY, which matches nothing.

matchAuthority.description: What the destination matches an existing record on. Never a Kauro-owned column: a trace key names a delivered record, it is not evidence about the destination instance.

onMatchConflict.description: What to do when two source records carry the same match value. Delivering both would make the destination merge them, so no policy does.

onMissingMatch.description: What to do with a row whose declared match value finds nothing at the destination.

recordMappingId.description: The record mapping this declaration governs.

anyOf.description: The mapped field on this record whose value is the match value.

anyOf.description: Asserts the exact set of worksheet names the workbook must contain; the run fails if it differs. Every sheet is always ingested so that no row escapes accounting. Null skips the assertion.

localeEvidence.description: Facts about the data that the engine may not infer for itself.

anyOf.description: Default date format for every DATE column.

occurrences.description: What to do with files that hold the same bytes inside one source namespace. Equal bytes in different namespaces are two occurrences and need no declaration. INDEPENDENT reads every listed file as its own export; EXCLUDE_ONE keeps the first listed file and rejects every row of the others, by name.

decision.description: Whether the listed files are independent exports or one is a copy to leave out.

files.description: The ids of the files the decision covers. Their bytes must be equal.

blankRow.description: Rows with no value in any column.

destinationKeyConflict.description: Distinct records colliding on the destination key.

formulaCachedValues.description: Whether a value the spreadsheet computed may be delivered. Formulas are never evaluated either way.

mergeFieldConflict.description: Proven-identical rows disagreeing on a populated field.

anyOf.description: Why PREFER_SURVIVOR is safe for this dataset. Required when that policy is selected.

rowShapeMismatch.description: Rows whose column count differs from the header.

authoritativeExternalIdColumns.description: Columns the customer declares to be authoritative external identifiers. Equal values in these columns prove two rows are one record.

destinationField.description: A canonical field name, or "custom:<Header>" for a destination-specific field.

onAmbiguous.description: What to do when the value cannot be interpreted with certainty. Default PRESERVE.

onInvalid.description: What to do when the value is invalid for its declared type. Default PRESERVE.

anyOf.description: Allowed options for ENUM.

caseTransform.description: Mechanical re-casing for TEXT. TITLE_SIMPLE upper-cases the first letter after the start of the value, Unicode whitespace, "-", "'" or "’", and has no dictionary of exceptions. Skipped when valueMap matched. Default PRESERVE.

clearWhenMatches.description: Values the customer authorizes the engine to erase, compared case-insensitively (after trimming, if this field trims). Requires destructiveAuthorization.

anyOf.description: Declared source date format for this column.
Decimal separator for NUMBER.

destructiveAuthorization.description: Explicit permission for this field mapping to turn a non-empty source value into an empty one.

anyOf.description: Destination field that receives a phone extension. Without it, numbers carrying an extension are preserved unchanged.

falseValues.description: Spellings that mean false, compared case-insensitively.

lowercaseDomain.description: For EMAIL, lowercase the domain part. The local part is never altered. Default true.

anyOf.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used for phone numbers with no international prefix.

Thousands separator for NUMBER, or NONE when the source uses no grouping.
A declared time zone for DATETIME values that carry no offset. Mutually exclusive with timezoneOffset. An offset the value carries always outranks it.

overlap.description: What to do with a local time that happens twice (the clocks go back): REFUSE leaves it AMBIGUOUS, EARLIER or LATER choose the first or second occurrence. A local time that does not exist (the clocks go forward) is always unresolved.

tzdata.description: The tzdata release the zone was declared against. It must equal the release of the runtime, or the plan is refused.

zone.description: An IANA time zone name, for example "Europe/Madrid".

anyOf.description: Time zone offset applied to timestamps that carry none, for example "+00:00".

trim.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from this field. Default false: whitespace is part of the value until a field approves removing it.

trueValues.description: Spellings that mean true, compared case-insensitively.

unicodeNormalization.description: Canonical Unicode composition for TEXT and ENUM. NFC composes; PRESERVE changes nothing. Default PRESERVE.

valueMap.description: Exact value substitutions for TEXT and ENUM. Array order carries no meaning and two entries that compare equal are rejected. A value that matches nothing is left for caseTransform and the semantic transform to handle.

from.description: The exact source value, compared after trimming and Unicode normalization if this field declares them, and never case-folded.

to.description: The exact value delivered in its place. It can never be empty; clearing a value is clearWhenMatches.

required.description: Treat a missing value as a reason to set the row aside. Default false.

semanticType.description: How the source value should be interpreted.

anyOf.description: Declares that this column carries consent, privacy or suppression meaning. Such a field is never resolved by a merge policy.
